For example, painting a standard bedroom in Blackburn might cost between $300 and $600, while a full interior repaint of a three-bedroom house could range from $5,000 to $10,000. Cleaning is the next critical step. Remove dirt, cobwebs, and mildew from walls and trim using appropriate cleaners.
